EFS/S14.title: Offline mid-typing and at Generate / Ask / Save Note, then back online (both contexts)
EFS/S14.detail: Hospital and Nursing Home; spec newspec-c/flt-efs-s14-offline-ai.spec.ts. Network cut = context.setOffline(true) plus the Convex socket closed and every reconnect refused until the cut ends (Chromium's offline emulation alone leaves an open WebSocket working). All model answers mocked at the socket; nothing reached it while offline. Judged 36/42: 3 checks fail in each context (h2–h4, n2–n4). Pass: the banner 'No network connection. What you dictate stays on this screen and saves when you’re back online; AI steps can be retried then.' appears a few seconds after the cut; both typed lines, the Ask question and the pre-round text stay on screen; after reconnect the banner goes (~3 s) and, after one more Save Note and a reload, both encounter lines and the pre-round typed offline are on screen and on the server; one note per chart (one generateNote call). Fail (U11, state 9): 20 s after each tap while offline the step is still on its busy label — 'Generating Note…', 'Searching…', 'Saving & Updating…' — with no message on the step (only the top banner); the Convex client queues the call and the app has no timeout. Recorded (Q2): after reconnect each queued step ran by itself — the note was generated and the chart jumped to Post-Round, the question was sent (its answer went to a closed sheet), the pre-round summary was processed. Note: had the socket still looked open when the step was tapped (a real drop the browser has not noticed yet), the call would instead fail after reconnect with 'Connection lost while action was in flight' (OAT-03/S16 shows that path); the spinner during the outage is the same either way.
EFS/S14.productIssue: A physician who taps Generate Note & Finish, Ask AI or Save Note while the network is down sees that step's spinner ('Generating Note…', 'Searching…', 'Saving & Updating…') for the whole outage with no message on the step, only the top no-network banner. When the connection returns the step runs by itself: a note can be generated and the screen jumps to Post-Round without a new tap.
